scoring_justification: All headline quantities (lattice constant, DOS at Fermi, surface energy, interlayer relaxations) can be recomputed from the raw DFT outputs.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for lattice constant, DOS at Fermi, surface energy, and interlayer spacing changes from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (a=4.33 Å), Fig.2(b) text (DOS≈0.3 eV⁻¹·atom⁻¹), Table 4 (σ=1.58 J/m² for 7-layer), Table 3 7-layer column for Δ₍₁₂₎, Δ₂₃, Δ₃₄ of C and Ti.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from the paper's reported results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values, used as the hidden reference for comparison.

schema.description: Quantum ESPRESSO pw.x output text. Contains the final lattice parameter (alat) or cell vectors (in Bohr or Angstrom) and the final total energy. The checker extracts the equilibrium lattice constant.

outputs.description: DFT output from bulk geometry optimization; checker extracts equilibrium lattice constant and compares to hidden gold.

schema.description: Two-column whitespace-separated text file, no header. Column 1: energy (eV) relative to Fermi energy. Column 2: total DOS in states/eV/atom. Checker interpolates to obtain DOS at E=0 eV.

outputs.description: Total density of states for bulk TiC; checker interpolates at the Fermi level and compares to hidden gold.

schema.description: Quantum ESPRESSO pw.x output from 7-layer slab relaxation. Contains final total energy and final atomic positions (fractional or Cartesian coordinates). Checker recomputes surface energy and interlayer spacing changes.

outputs.description: Relaxed 7-layer slab output; checker computes surface energy and interlayer relaxations and compares to hidden gold.

required.interlayer_spacings: array of objects, each with 'species' (string 'C' or 'Ti'), 'layer_pair' (string '12','23','34'), 'delta_percent' (float)

outputs.description: Structured summary of reproduced results; checker verifies consistency with recomputed quantities from raw DFT outputs.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes lattice constant, DOS at Fermi, surface energy, and interlayer relaxations from the raw artifacts, then verifies that the agent-reported values in results.json match within a tight tolerance. All hidden gold values are derived from the paper's reported numbers.

steps.description: Check that |Δ12| > |Δ23| > |Δ34| for each species (C and Ti)
Verify agent-reported values in results.json are consistent with recomputed values from raw artifacts (loose tolerance).
